author: Kairos I
title: Entropy v1.9: CI toggles + configurable weighting (v38–v42)
abstract: Runs v1.9 with nonparam ks_beta (0), inv_var weighting, B=1000, seed=42 across v38–v42; writes CSV+JSON summaries.

original_submission.content:
import os, shlex, subprocess
specs = [
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v38_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v39_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v40_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v41_specimen.json',
  'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json',
]
cmd = "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v1_9.py 0 inv_var 1000 42 " + " ".join(specs)
rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
print("RUN_V19_RC", rc)
